workstation.description: Read bounded journal records accessible to the ordinary SSH identity; visibility depends on its permissions and may be incomplete.
List installed packages from the available apt, rpm or apk inventory without refreshing caches or installing anything.

List loaded or installed systemd units matching unit_pattern, one bounded page per call; pass next_offset as offset until it is absent. "*" keeps the first 256 matches (truncated stays true); narrower patterns fail closed if more than 256 units match.
